_comment: Clock-domain letters and block letters for the net-naming stage tag.
Read by tools/lint-rtl.py; nothing is generated from this file, because
nothing in RTL or C++ consumes the letters -- only the linter does.
domain   letter for the clock domain the signal is generated in. Taken
from the segment immediately before `_clk` in the generating
block    letter for the block that generates the signal.
NN       two-digit pipe stage within that block.
l|h      generating clock edge: h = posedge, l = negedge.
WHAT IS AND IS NOT DECIDED HERE. The MECHANISM is Stage 1d. The block
LIST is Stage 2's and follows from the partition, which §2 of the
strategy doc is explicit has not been decided. Blocks marked provisional
exist only so the mechanism has something to exercise; they are not a
Single letters mean 26 blocks maximum, minus the reserved ones. If the
Stage 2 partition needs more than that, this format has to widen -- and
that is much cheaper to discover here than after a tree of RTL carries

domains.doc: The core clock domain. §6 makes this the only functional domain: globally synchronous, single frequency. `core_clk` at the top, uniquified to `<block>_core_clk` after each block's global gate.

DFT clock. Asynchronous to core by construction -- which is exactly why the domain segment is not `core`. Nothing uses it yet; it is registered so that the first signal crossing from it is a lint finding rather than a surprise.

blocks.name: reset
blocks.doc: RESERVED for the reset distribution network, which does not share a numbering space with any block's datapath. A synchronous reset cannot be delivered globally in one cycle; it is pipelined, and how deep it is when it reaches a block depends on physical distance. So `<blk>_rst_r06h` says 'six stages into the reset tree', and it cannot be confused with a datapath signal at stage 6. Reset nets are exempt from stage arithmetic for the same reason.

blocks.name: reference
blocks.doc: PROVISIONAL. Carries the pre-Stage-2 reference material -- the interface checker example and the smoke modules -- so the naming rules have something real to check before the partition exists. Not a block.
